title: The End and The Hub
note: Shots carry an end- or hub- prefix: review/b15/sbs holds copies of review/baseline/end and /hub (reshot in B15 on a build of unchanged main; the B0 sets are kept as end-b0 and hub-b0) and of the final after shots. B15 added close spots for a partition wall with ghost marks, a partition poster, a gondola shelf, the EXIT door in its vestibule and a troffer in The End; a tunnel lamp, a carved door, its sigil, a service door, the Tower's ornate doors and the Tower's wall and stair in the Hub. The Hub is lit amber by design; The End's lights go out now and then (its lore).
